narr: Deep monsoon moisture allowed the formation of thunderstorms with heavy rain and flash flooding across northern Arizona.
ev: Heavy rain over the Pipeline, Tunnel, and Schultz Fire scars caused flash flooding that closed Highway 89 in both directions from mile marker 426 to 434.

Heavy rain in Utah caused a flash flood in the Paria River that drains into Arizona and the Colorado River near Lees Ferry. The river gauge near on the Paria River near the Colorado River peaked at 6.8 feet at 600 AM.
A video of flash flooding in Antelope Canyon was posted on social media.
The river gauge on Granite Creek showed a rise of 2.55 feet in 90 minutes (at 1130 AM). Flooding was reported on Highway 69 near milepost 295.
